capabilities.description: Ingests the Harbourline BOQ and holds it as the priced source of record for all claim measurement and valuation.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record
Preliminaries: P1 Site establishment & temporary facilities; P2 Site security & fencing (6 months); P3 Survey & setting out; P4 Project signboard; P5 As-built documentation
Earthworks: E1 Bulk excavation to reduced level; E2 Disposal of surplus material off-site; E3 Imported granular fill, compacted; E4 Trench excavation for services; E5 Geotextile separation layer

capabilities.description: Prepares and certifies Interim Payment Certificates against measured BOQ quantities, applying the contract retention terms.
requirements: Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period
Clause 4.2 Performance Security: 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount

capabilities.description: Tracks the Time for Completion and computes delay damages per contract clause 8.7, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.
requirements: Clause 8.2 Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date
Clause 8.7 Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount

capabilities.description: Captures and tracks Inspection and Test Plan records and quality assurance evidence against the works.
Maintains a controlled register of contract and project documents, linking each record to its source document and version.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

capabilities.description: Tracks the Defects Notification Period and the release of the second half of retention at its end.
requirements: Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period: 365 days from Taking-Over
Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that manages progress claims, delay-damages tracking, QA/ITP records, and a document register, using the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record. It serves the project's contract administration team, quantity surveyors, and QA engineers by tying every claim and record back to the contract clauses and BOQ items.
